trap.label: over- = demais
trap.wrong: I overlooked the cake and it burned.
trap.why: Overlook em inglês é ignorar. O brasileiro ligaria over- a "demais". Escolha o verbo certo.

fix.wrong: I overlooked the cake; it's burned.
fix.right: I overbaked the cake; it's burned.

fix.wrong: She underestimated the cost and paid too much.
fix.right: She overestimated the cost and paid too much.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “He overcooks the rice.”
Reescreva com over-: “She worked too much.”
Reescreva com over-: “Don't mix too much.”
